title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: Elizabeth Bennet and Fitzwilliam Darcy confront pride, first impressions, and social expectations.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
summary: An independent governess searches for dignity, belonging, and love while guarding her principles.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
summary: A destructive bond between Catherine and Heathcliff echoes across two generations on the moors.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
summary: A scientist creates life and then abandons it, setting creator and creation on a tragic path.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
summary: A group of allies confronts Count Dracula as his influence spreads from Transylvania to England.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A Victorian inventor travels into a distant future divided by the consequences of social inequality.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
summary: An unnamed narrator struggles to survive after technologically superior Martians invade England.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
summary: Jay Gatsby pursues an idealized past amid wealth, performance, and disillusionment in the Jazz Age.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
summary: Ishmael joins Captain Ahab's obsessive voyage to hunt the white whale that maimed him.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
summary: The four March sisters grow toward adulthood while balancing family, creativity, work, and love.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate twelve cases through observation and deduction.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
summary: A young man preserves his beauty while a hidden portrait records the cost of his choices.
